book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Lasaras uma
Ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani nɨbö bɨ ap nan ga; hib nɨpe u Lasaras. Bɨ anɨbu, nɨñɨn nɨpe mɨhöp mɨdmɨdil; ap Maria, ap Mada.
Maria me, Jisas nɨp ma kɨd nɨpe u wel hoŋ gɨ ñöm, umagö nɨpe ud ƚɨk gɨ yua nɨbi anɨbu. Nɨmam nɨpe Lasaras nan ga.
Lasaras nɨñɨn mɨhau Jisas nɨp manö bɨg yumil haglö, “Bɨ Kub! Bɨ mɨdmagö ne u nan göp,” a gɨlö.

Pen Jisas manö hag yulö anɨbu nɨŋöm haga, “Nɨpe nan göp pen böŋ nöp umagnab. Pen God nɨpe ke nɨŋöb rö, nɨpe kƚö ke nɨpe gö, nɨbi bɨ gau God hib nɨpe u abe, God Ñɨ hib nɨpe u abe haglö adö arnab, a göm ga,” a ga.
Jisas nɨpe Mada, nɨñɨn nɨpe Maria, nɨmam kale Lasaras kalɨp yam mɨdmagö lɨmɨdöp.
Pen Lasaras nan ga manö anɨbu nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨp nɨŋnɨg yɨŋɨd araga; ram mɨnöŋ mɨdeia au ñɨn mɨhöp halö mɨdeia.
Ñɨn mɨhöp lugö, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp haga, “Ram mɨnöŋ Judia ado gɨ arun,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, bɨ nɨpe gau hagla, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ. Rol magö u nöp, bɨ Juda gau nöp kabö ju paknɨg geila u pen ne kuöyaŋ ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu ado gɨ arnɨg gabön aka?” gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Kale nɨŋbim, ñɨn añɨ ap, aua unbö mɨgan laŋ nöp mɨdöp. Nɨbi bɨ mailö halö ajeinaböl gau, mɨnöŋ naböŋ mailö anɨbu mailö ñö, nan rɨmnap kalpe li ludö arö ap lug pakagnaböl.
Pen nɨbi bɨ sɨbön yaŋ ajeinaböl gau, mailö kale mɨdagö, nan rɨmnap kalpe li ludö arö ap lug paknaböl,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm, manö ap halö kalɨp hagöm haga, “Bɨ nɨŋeb hon Lasaras hon hanab; pen yad amem nɨp hagnö urak aunab,” a ga.
Hageia, bɨ nɨpe gau pen hagla, “Bɨ Kub. Nɨpe hanab a gɨpan rö, kamɨŋ lɨnab,” a gɨla.
Jisas nɨpe Lasaras hadö umöb u nɨŋöm, “Lasaras hon hanab,” a ga. Pen bɨ nɨpe gau Jisas manö nɨpe nɨŋöm, Lasaras yɨharɨŋ hon hanab a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋla.
Bɨ nɨpe gau nɨŋagep adö mɨdeila nɨŋöm Jisas kalɨp waiö hagöm haga, “Lasaras hadö umöb.
Pen yad Lasaras aip mɨdagainö umöb u, kalöp nan a gem mɨñ mɨñ gɨpin. Anɨg göp u me, kale manö yad nɨŋ udmim rö löp. Pen Lasaras mɨdöp au arun,” a ga.
Hageia, Domas Didimas nɨpe Jisas bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap gau kalɨp haga, “Hon magöŋhalö manö hag ñeb bɨ hon aip ram mɨnöŋ Judia arno, nɨp al pak löm, hanɨp abe al pak löl,” a ga.
Jisas Mada Maria añɨl mɨhau kalɨp manö haga
Pen kale ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani amjakeila, nɨbi bɨ gau Jisas nɨp hagla, “Lasaras uma rɨgöl gɨno, ñɨn mɨhau mɨhau padiöp,” a gɨla.
Pen ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani anɨbu, Jerusalem söl au, kilomida unbö mɨhau nɨgaŋ rö nöp mɨdmɨdöp rö me,
Lasaras umö, Juda nɨbi bɨ iru nöp apöm, Mada Maria añɨl mɨhau mög nɨŋöm mɨɫöŋ magö gɨ mɨdeila.
Pen Jisas auab, a gɨlö, Mada nɨŋöm, nɨñɨn Maria nɨp ram u arö göm, am Jisas nɨp nɨŋnɨg ara.
Mada nɨpe am Jisas nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Bɨ Kub. Ne i mɨdaibnap, mam yad Lasaras umagböp.
Pen yad nɨŋbin, mɨñi God nɨp nan nɨhön hag nɨŋeinabön, hagnabön rö gɨnab,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Namam kuöyaŋ uraknab,” a ga.
Hageia, Mada haga, “Yad nɨŋbin manö kub hagep ñɨn u uraknab,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Yad ke gɨnö nɨbi bɨ uraknaböl; yad ke gɨnö nɨbi bɨ kamɨŋ mɨdeinaböl. Nɨbi bɨ yɨp nɨŋ udöm umnaböl gau, kamɨŋ mɨdeinaböl.
Nɨbi bɨ kamɨŋ mɨdöm yɨp nɨŋ udnaböl gau, umagnaböl; pör nöp pör nöp kamɨŋ mɨdeinaböl. Manö hagabin anɨbi nɨŋ udpan aka?” ga.
Jisas anɨg hageia, Mada haga, “Bɨ Kub. Yaue, yad nɨŋbin, ne me Krais u, God Ñɨ nɨpe mɨnöŋ naböŋ i aunab, a gɨmɨdal u nöp,” a ga.
Mada manö anɨbu hagöm, ram ado gɨ amöm, nɨñɨn nɨpe Maria nɨp rɨmɨd iƚ gau mumug rɨköm haga, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ hadö auub; nöp mai a göm hag nɨŋab,” a ga.
Maria manö anɨbu nɨŋöm yɨŋɨd uraköm, Jisas nɨp nɨŋnɨg ara.
Pen Jisas ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani hadö auaga; Mada nɨp nɨŋa mɨgan anɨb au nöp mɨdeia.
Maria nɨpe anɨg yɨŋɨd arö, Juda nɨbi bɨ nɨp aip ram raul mɨdeila gau hag nɨŋla e, wip rɨgöl daŋ mɨɫöŋ gɨnɨg arab, a göm, arö nɨŋöl gɨ hain arla.
Maria am Jisas nɨp nɨŋöm, mɨdeia ma iƚ au maben yɨmöm haga, “Bɨ Kub, ne aui mɨdaibnap, mam yad umagböp!” a ga.
Pen Maria abe, Juda nɨbi bɨ nɨpe aip aula gau abe mɨɫöŋ geila u nɨŋöm, Jisas gasɨ hibur mɨdmagö nɨpe mög kub yabɨƚ ga.
Anɨg gö, Jisas haga, “Nɨp rɨgöl gɨpim gai?” ö ga. Hageia hagla, “Auö am nɨŋun,” a gɨla.
Jisas amgö ñɨg luga.
Jisas amgö ñɨg lugeia u nɨŋöm, Juda nɨbi bɨ gau nɨŋöm hagla, “Nɨŋim! Lasaras nɨp mɨdmagö yabɨƚ löp!” a gɨla.
Rɨmnap pen hagla, “Nɨpe bɨ amgö we ga u nɨp gö amgö ñɨl nɨŋa rö, nɨhön gɨnɨg nan bɨ anɨbi nɨp ga u gö kamɨŋ laga?” ö gɨla.
Jisas Lasaras nɨp gö, uraka
Pen Jisas kuöyaŋ gasɨ hibur mɨdmagö nɨpe mög kub yabɨƚ nɨŋöm, Lasaras nɨp rɨgöl gɨla mɨgan u amjaka. Wip rɨgöl gɨla anɨbu, kabö mɨgan ap rɨgöl gɨla; pen kabö kub ap ud ajöŋ pɨƚ gɨlö mɨdeia.
Pen Jisas bɨ gau haga, “Kabö u ud yuim,” a ga. Jisas anɨg hageia, bɨ Lasaras uma anɨbu nɨñɨn nɨpe Mada haga, “Bɨ Kub, wip u umö rɨgöl gɨno, ñɨn mɨhau mɨhau padiöp u, haƚɨŋ naij yabɨƚ aunab,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas pen haga, “Nöp nɨhön hagajɨn? Nöp hagpin, ‘Yɨp nɨŋ ud mɨdmön me, God kƚö nɨpe ke nɨŋnabön,’ a gɨpin,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, kabö u ud yulö, Jisas gɨlaŋ gɨ nɨŋöm haga, “Bapi, yad nöp hag nɨŋnö yɨp nɨŋban u, nöp aij a gabin.
Yad nöp hag nɨŋnö yɨp pör nɨŋban u hadö nɨŋbin, pen manö hagabin anɨbi, nɨbi bɨ aui urak mɨdpal gai, ne nöp yɨp yuö aunö u nɨŋ udöl, a gem hagabin,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm, meg mɨgan dap ranöm haga, “Lasaras, ne höŋ aui au!” a ga.

Hageia, waƚɨj ñɨn ma nɨp wam wam haluöm, nabɨc maj mɨgan waƚɨj wam wam göm, dam rɨgöl gɨla waƚɨj gau, anɨg göl mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, wip he mɨlö u urak waƚɨj halö wam wam göm höŋ aua. Auö, Jisas bɨ gau kalɨp haga, “Waƚɨj nɨp wam halubim gau hubɨk yube araŋ,” a ga. Hageia, haga rö gɨla.
Jisas nɨp alun a göm gasɨ u nɨŋla
Juda nɨbi bɨ Maria nɨp nɨŋnɨg aula anɨb gau, Jisas Lasaras nɨp gö uraka u nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp Jisas nɨpe Krais u a göm, nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Pen rɨmnap ado gɨ bɨ Perisi mɨdeila au amöm, Jisas ga anɨbu kalɨp hag ñɨla.

Hag ñeila, bɨ Perisi gau abe, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, kale Juda Kansol manö ud asɨk lɨmɨdal bɨ kub gau kalɨp wɨñ allö, am magum geila, kalɨp hagla, “Bɨ anɨbu nan gagep iru nöp gab u, hon nɨhön gɨnabun?

Hon nɨŋun arö gɨno, nɨpe anɨbu nöp gö arö, nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö nɨp nɨŋ udöm, kiŋ kub hon a geinaböl u, Rom bɨ kub gau apöm, God sabe gep ram hon u gɨ naij göm, hanɨp Juda nɨbi bɨ gɨ naij göm, gɨnaböl,” a gɨla.
Pen mɨ anɨbu nöp, bɨ ap nɨp hag lɨlö, nɨpe bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u mɨdeia. Bɨ anɨbu hib nɨpe Kaiapas. Nɨpe magum geila aŋ u manö hagöm haga, “Kalöp gasɨ lagöp.
Yad kalöp hagabin, bɨ añɨ ap umö hon magöŋhalö kamɨŋ arnabun u aij; hon magöŋhalö umnabun u naij,” a ga.

Kaiapas nɨpe manö haga anɨbu, nɨpe ke hagaga; nɨpe bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ mɨ anɨbu mɨdeia rö, nɨpe nan nɨhön nɨhön hainö gɨnab gau gasɨ nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨpe Juda nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp a göm umnab, a ga.
Pen Juda kai kalɨp nöp wasö; nɨbi bɨ God ñɨ pai nɨpe udnɨg gab gau magöŋhalö ud jɨm ñöm lö, iƚ nɨpe añɨ yabɨƚ mɨdeinaböl, a göm umnab, a ga.
Anɨb u, ñɨn anɨbu iƚ göm, Juda bɨ kub anɨb gau Jisas nɨp aige gun alun, a göm, pör nöp manö anɨbu nöp hag amɨl apɨl gɨ mɨdeila.

Juda bɨ kub gau Jisas nɨp alnɨg geila u nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ kale ram mɨnöŋ Judia waiö ajagmɨdöp; nɨpe bɨ nɨpe gau aip ram mɨnöŋ Judia au ju am Epraim daun amjaköm, mɨnöŋ naböŋ kabö nöp mɨdmɨdöp goƚ au mɨdmɨdal.

Pen Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub kale u söl söl ga nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp ram mɨnöŋ kale ke gau arö göm, hon God amgö ilö nɨbi bɨ uɫ aij mɨdun, Pasopa nan ñɨŋun, a göm, wög adö kale hadame gau gɨmɨdal rö gɨnɨg Jerusalem arla.

Kale Jerusalem apjaköm, Jisas nɨp uƚhai nɨŋ mɨdeila. Kale amöm God sabe gep ram raul mɨgan u mɨdöm, Jisas mai, a göm, pen hag nɨŋö pen hag nɨŋö göm hagla, “Kale nɨhön gasɨ nɨŋbim? Nɨpe Pasopa ñɨn i aunab aka wasö?” gɨla.
Pen God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ Perisi gau abe, manö ap hagla, “Nɨbi bɨ ap Jisas nɨp nɨŋainɨm u, nɨpe ap hanɨp hageinab, hon am nɨp ud sɨsɨ lun,” a gɨla.
